newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Robotics buy ratings repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Robotics buy ratings repeated.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns analyst Eric Blachno said he reiterated his buy rating on U.S. Robotics Corp after the modem maker reported "solid" fourth quarter earnings.
-- Blachno said Tuesday his estimates remain at $0.74 a share for the first quarter, compared with $0.45 a year ago, and $3.30 for fiscal 1997, compared with $2.36.

-- Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette analyst Eric Buck also reiterated his buy recommendation on U.S. Robotics. Buck's earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 remains $3.25 a share, which he said is "quite conservative."
-- Oppenheimer analyst Steven Levy said he also repeated his buy rating on modem maker U.S. Robotics Corp. His earnings estimates remain $3.50 a share for fiscal 1997 on $3.0 billion in sales.

-- On Monday, U.S. Robotics reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.71 a share, in line with estimates, excluding a charge. "Clearly, investors were concerned that the company would not make estimates. That's out of the way," Blachno said.

-- Blachno said he expected U.S. Robotics to capitalize on its leading technology in the modem and remote access systems business. "We think if it executes well, it could accelerate its market share gains in both segments of the networking market," Blachno said.
-- U.S. Robotics shares were up 3-1/4 at 62-3/4 afer trading as high as 65-1/4 earlier in the day.
